data.origin: EIA Europe Brent Spot Price FOB
data.frequency: daily closing spot quotes, not futures or intraday
data.requiredExport: official ALFRED initial-release records with per-observation availability date
data.sourceVintageAssurance: ALFRED availability date, not exact EIA original release instant
data.schemaOrAvailabilityFailure: stop; no assumed-lag fallback under this protocol

issuance.deduplicate: one issue per unique initial-release batch only when latest known quote date advances; never one issue per quote in a batch
issuance.issueTime: 00:00:00Z two calendar days after availability date
issuance.featureQuotes: initial-release values only; never revise silently or mix futures
issuance.anchor: first valid quote date strictly after issue UTC date
issuance.endpoint: anchor index plus horizon valid quote intervals
issuance.target: P(endpoint_price > anchor_price); complement is non-up including ties, not down
issuance.featureCutoff: availability batch date D; issue at D+2 UTC, intentionally do not use records arriving after D
issuance.labelPriceVersion: anchor and endpoint use initial-release values only, never latest-revised prices
issuance.labelMatureAt: max(initial availability date + 2 calendar days at UTC00 for anchor and endpoint)
issuance.featureWindow: latest21 valid quotes known by batch D, sorted by quote date; no future release, no forward fill
issuance.lookbackSpanDefinition: latestQuoteDate minus earliest of latest21 quote dates
issuance.futureSpanDefinition: issue UTC date to endpoint quote date; select first actual future anchor and fixed offset once, never search farther to repair a failure

splits.purge: label endpoint quote date AND both label values conservative availability times must precede next phase calendar start; all evaluation labels must be mature by actual retrieval cutoff
splits.testUse: single frozen run, no tuning after outcomes
splits.holdoutReporting: report 2026 separately, even if unavailable or failed; never pool with 2021-2025 or use to retune; failure/unavailability prevents any claim of current qualification

model.scaling: train mean/std only; reject nonfinite; standard-deviation zero column maps zero
model.penalty: lambda * sum(nonintercept_weight_squared) / 2 added to mean logloss
model.calibration: input raw classifier logits; minimize mean logloss + 0.01*slope^2/2; intercept not penalized; same deterministic optimizer/convergence rules; positive final slope required
model.calibrationValidity: positive fitted slope and finite fit required; constant/nearly constant raw logits (variance<1e-8) or nonpositive slope => unavailable
model.initialization: classifier all weights and intercept zero; calibration slope1 and intercept0

baselines: empirical pretest up frequency using train+calibration labels

bootstrap.kind: paired noncircular moving blocks of issue records
bootstrap.sensitivityRule: report all; block8 remains primary; no selection based on interval/results
bootstrap.limitation: blocks are issuance records, not days; research uncertainty intervals do not guarantee nominal coverage under all serial dependence or regime shifts

primaryResearchIncrementGate.pairedBoundAppliesTo: separate upper95percent delta Brier against each simple baseline

evaluation.pairing: all predeclared eligible cases, identical complete paired samples for candidate and both simple baselines; no selective dropping based on forecast or outcome
evaluation.holdoutGate: same frozen metrics/gates when minimum samples/classes met; otherwise unavailable; lower sample precision disclosed; cannot overturn failed primary test

futureReviewNeeds: verified actual input availability and series identity
at least 100 distinct prospective matured primary issues spanning at least 12 months
independent audit and complete uncertainty/missingness disclosures
